messages:
hana: FYI I found a small slice where 4-bit reranker has MRR@1 mismatch despite ndcg@10 stable. small queries with parentheses seem affected.

josh: parentheses? like queries with (error) parts? any tokenization artifacts?

hana: example: query "install (docker)". prod tokens: ["install", "(", "docker", ")"] but eval tokens missing separate paren tokens: ["install", "(docker)"]. BPE merges because preproc removed spaces near punctuation.

eval-bot: uploaded sample diffs artifact s-2026-03-19-09.

miko: is this the same change that strips adjacent punctuation in the preproc? I thought we only normalized unicode.

hana: there's a microfix in html normalization that joined paren to words when immediate adjacency existed. small change but high signal for short queries.

ron: for immediate mitigation could we add a preproc step that inserts spaces around punctuation for eval parity? Also add a unit test for token boundaries.

hana: queued a patch to eval-harness to force punctuation spacing for bring-up runs. will run quick ablation.

josh: add this to the short_query holdout checks; we need to ensure gating doesn't let int4 ship with >0.03 MRR drop in top1.

eval-bot: ablation run queued: s-2026-03-19-09a. expected 30m.

hana: thanks. will post results when ready.

josh: nice catch. small preproc detail, big user-facing effect. :100:
